{{dablink|For other uses of the word "dance," see [[Dance]].}}
'''The Dancing Cartman''' is an inn located in the village of [[Four Kings]], run by [[Saml Hake]]. [[Jak]] and [[Strom]] are its bouncers.

[[Rand]] and [[Mat]] play in the common room for a single night, for room and board. They also meet [[Howal Gode]], a [[Darkfriend]], there.  In a late-night confrontation Gode tries to persuade them to give up and serve the [[Dark Lord]].  It is in this confrontation, as a thunderstorm rages outside, that Rand  [[channel]]s unconsciously,  calling down a lightning bolt that destroys the wall to help him and Mat escape.
